hints.title: Linear Filter
hints.text: Iterate through the array of words and check if the given character appears in each word.

hints.title: Substrings Membership
hints.text: If x is found in words[i], append index i to the result list.

hints.title: Preserve Order
hints.text: Because we scan from index 0 upward, the result list is naturally sorted in ascending order.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass string search over all words.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space beyond returned indices.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use built-in string membership checks or single-pass search.
